authorization: The construct-certified v22 host is authorized for one separately governed performance-only runtime repair. No external acquisition code, artifact, data, output, or evidence is imported into LayerCake.
objective: Eliminate redundant authenticated package deserialization during route-isolated core activation and elide repeated writes of an already active identical residual-route state, while preserving package security, registry lifecycle, tensor values, FP32 numerical behavior, persistent state, output bytes, ABI identity, and every v17-v22 construct behavior.

bounded_changes.installer: Add an install-inspected path that accepts only a CakePackage already validated by the same installer, repeats host compatibility validation, checks dependencies, stores the content-addressed blob, and writes the identical registry record. Existing install and update APIs retain their behavior.
bounded_changes.activation: Inspect and authenticate the source exactly once, validate the route-isolated role, install that exact inspected object, and bind its tensors without reloading the source or registry blob.
bounded_changes.route_state: Cache only the exact (route, batch) assignment already written to every block and elide a repeated identical assignment. Any route or batch change still writes a new tensor before execution.

decision_rule: Implement exactly the bounded change, add hostile tests proving that install-inspected cannot bypass host/dependency/signature provenance and that one activation performs one package parse, verify repeated-route elision and changed-route execution, run focused tests, the complete repository suite, and the unchanged Phase 0-8 verifier, then independently recompute the result. Any output, tensor, ABI, security, lifecycle, or verifier change fails the repair.
claim_boundary: Generic LayerCake hosting/runtime repair only. No external artifact, ABI acquisition, English quality, information minimum, physical speed or memory, campaign-phase recertification, or ABI-superiority claim.
